name: Skindeep — Cosmetic Geneware Aesthetics Circle
description: Skindeep practitioners treat their bodies as living canvases, cycling through cosmetic geneware modifications the way earlier generations changed clothes — seasonal scales, temporary chromatic skin patches, and patterned bioluminescent traceries that fade within months. The community is centered around the Molt, a biannual event held in the submerged parking structures beneath the Calderon-Vásquez Interchange in Tier 2-3 where members debut new modifications and vote on aesthetic trends. Internal hierarchy is determined not by wealth but by originality of expression — members who repeat popular trends are called Echoes, a mild social stigma. The community's lingua franca borrows from Portuguese, Tagalog, and Yoruba slang, producing a creole they call Dermish.
cultural_impact: Skindeep has normalized the idea of impermanence in body modification, pushing back against the chrome-permanence ethos of older aug cultures and making geneware clinics in Tier 2 corridors significantly more profitable. Their seasonal aesthetic cycles have begun influencing mainstream fashion forecasting services operated by Vantage Couture LLC.
locations: The Molt pop-up circuit, Tier 2-3 border
Flensed Gallery, East Shelf overflow district
story_hooks: A Skindeep member surfaces with a modification that no licensed geneware clinic will admit to performing — the pattern is self-replicating and spreading beyond its intended boundaries, and someone is very interested in who designed it.

The biannual Molt is raided by Vantage Couture LLC operatives claiming IP theft on a proprietary bioluminescent pattern — the accused modifier insists they developed it independently, and the community fractures over whether to fight or settle.

A player character is hired to locate an Echo — a low-status trend-repeater — who has gone missing after reportedly debuting a modification that exactly replicated the private body art of a Tier 5 Spire executive.
